Acid_Dissolve_Maw.description: The Acid_Dissolve_Maw is a gaping orifice lined with translucent, gelatinous teeth that constantly drip with a vile, bubbling acid, capable of eating through the toughest metal or flesh with alarming speed. Its surface feels slick and cold to the touch, and when activated, it emits a nauseating hiss before launching a jet of corrosive liquid that can melt armor and ensnare foes in a sticky, acid-infused ooze.

Engulf_Mass_Maw.description: The Engulf_Mass_Maw is a gaping, churning void of dark, viscous ooze that pulsates with a malevolent life of its own, its edges constantly shifting to engulf anything that comes within reach, while its interior clings and squeezes, drawing in and digesting prey whole.

Necrotic_Drain_Maw.description: The Necrotic_Drain_Maw is a gaping, gelatinous mouth filled with razor-sharp, blackened teeth that drip with a noxious, green ichor. Its touch feels like a cold, slimy embrace, and its presence is accompanied by a pervasive stench that saps the life force from its surroundings, leaving only withered, pale remnants in its wake.

Magma_Fire_Maw.description: The Magma_Fire_Maw is a grotesque, gaping mouth lined with jagged, obsidian teeth that glisten with molten lava and seeping ooze, capable of exhaling a scorching breath that leaves the air shimmering with heat and can incinerate foes with a touch.

Void_Drain_Maw.description: The Void_Drain_Maw is a gaping, obsidian orifice that pulsates with a sickly, swirling void energy, its edges constantly shifting like viscous, dark ooze, granting its bearer unparalleled stealth and strength in the shadows.

Electric_Shock_Maw.description: The Electric Shock Maw is a grotesque, pulsating mass of slick, blue-tinged flesh that constantly crackles with low-level electrical discharges. Its gaping mouth is lined with sharp, jagged teeth that spark violently when clenched, and its touch can send paralyzing jolts through even the mightiest of foes.

Ice_Freeze_Maw.description: The Ice_Freeze_Maw is a gaping, frigid maw lined with jagged, translucent teeth that seem to ooze a chilling liquid, capable of constricting foes in a freezing grip and slowing their movements to a crawl with a mere breath.

Paralytic_Maw.description: The Paralytic_Maw is a grotesque, amorphous mouth filled with dozens of sharp, translucent teeth that shimmer with a sickly green glow, embedded in gums that secrete a viscous, numbing ooze capable of instantly paralyzing prey. As it opens, the maw reveals a cavernous interior lined with muscular pouches that can constrict and crush, leading down to a throat lined with backward-facing spines that guide victims into the stomach of the creature, ready to be digested.

Spore_Maw.description: The Spore_Maw is a grotesque orifice, pulsating with an unnatural, sickly glow, from which tendrils of viscous ooze constantly seep and congeal into clouds of infectious spores, ready to unleash a barrage of debilitating diseases upon the unwary.

Ochre_Slick_Maw.description: The Ochre_Slick_Maw is a grotesque, dripping appendage that resembles a mouth filled with writhing, acidic ooze, capable of both dissolving metal and binding foes in a sticky, corrosive embrace.

Cubic_Swallow_Maw.description: The Cubic Swallow Maw is a pulsating, gelatinous cube with a cavernous, dripping mouth that can unhinge to swallow prey whole, its interior lined with paralyzing tendrils that immobilize victims while it secretes an adhesive ooze to ensnare and constrict struggling foes.

Eldritch_Void_Maw.description: The Eldritch_Void_Maw is a writhing, amorphous orifice that pulses with an otherworldly darkness, its edges constantly shifting and dripping with viscous, sentient ooze. The mere presence of this unholy mouth induces a creeping sense of dread and irrational fear, while its touch can drain the very sanity and vitality from those who dare to approach too closely.
